_readme: Strings the scanner cannot see because they reach t()/rt() as runtime values.
prefer  name of the app repo whose table must win for this key, when the
two repos translate the same English word in different SENSES.
value   explicit wording per language, for keys no app table can supply.
Partial maps are fine; languages left out fall back to the tables.
